item.title: Councilmembers break down Casper budgets, challenges during Casper College event
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. –– The city of Casper is still grappling with loss of revenue to its general fund after the Wyoming Legislature passed property tax relief last year, while also dealing with aging infrastructure and inflationary pressures. item.title: State Supreme Court upholds 42- to 75-year sentence for Casper teen who killed ex-girlfriend
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — The Wyoming Supreme Court has upheld the 42- to 75-year sentence imposed last year for Eavan Castaner, who was 15 years old when he shot and killed his ex-girlfriend Lane’a Brown in Casper on May 14, 2024. item.title: Casper to seek grant for improving urban tree canopy
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — The Casper City Council agreed on Tuesday to seek a $100,000 grant for bolstering the city’s tree canopy and addressing related public safety concerns. item.title: Wyoming State Parks surpasses 5 million visitors in 2025
item.description: CHEYENNE, Wyo. — Wyoming State Parks recently announced that system-wide visitation surpassed the 5-million-visitor milestone in 2025. A release from Wyoming State Parks says that the agency saw 5,048,419 visitors, a 5% increase over 2024. This makes it the highest visitation level since the 2020–21 recreation surge.
